body:
## Pull request overview

This PR implements Phase 11 L1 (Grid Excellence) and Phase 12 L1 (Record Detail) foundation features per the ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md specifications. The implementation adds frozen column support, row height toggle, cell copy functionality to grids, and prev/next navigation, comments, and activity timeline to detail views. All 20 new tests pass (164 total across plugin-grid + plugin-detail).

**Changes:**
- Added frozen columns support with sticky CSS positioning and visual separators for grids
- Implemented row height toggle (compact/medium/tall) with dynamic cellClassName and toolbar UI
- Added cell copy (Ctrl+C/Cmd+C) functionality with clipboard API integration
- Introduced prev/next record navigation with position indicator in DetailView
- Created RecordComments and ActivityTimeline components with full test coverage
- Extended type definitions for CommentEntry, ActivityEntry, recordNavigation, and grid features

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 14 out of 14 changed files in this pull request and generated 7 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/types/src/views.ts | Added CommentEntry and ActivityEntry interfaces; extended DetailViewSchema with recordNavigation, comments, activities, onAddComment props |
| packages/types/src/objectql.ts | Added rowHeight prop to ObjectGridSchema for density control |
| packages/types/src/index.ts | Exported CommentEntry and ActivityEntry types |
| packages/types/src/data-display.ts | Added frozenColumns, onColumnResize, onColumnReorder to DataTableSchema |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx | Implemented row height toggle with cyclic state management and toolbar UI; integrated frozenColumns into DataTable props |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/index.tsx | Exported RecordComments and ActivityTimeline components with their prop types |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordComments.test.tsx | Added 9 comprehensive tests for RecordComments component (rendering, user interactions, submit handling) |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/DetailView.test.tsx | Added 5 tests for prev/next navigation UI and behavior, plus tests for comments/activities integration |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/ActivityTimeline.test.tsx | Added 6 tests for ActivityTimeline component (rendering, descriptions, type-specific icons) |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordComments.tsx | New component with comment list, avatars (image or initials), relative timestamps, textarea input with Ctrl+Enter submit |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/DetailView.tsx | Added prev/next navigation buttons with position indicator, integrated RecordComments and ActivityTimeline components |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/ActivityTimeline.tsx | New component with type-specific icons/colors, field change descriptions, relative timestamps, vertical timeline UI |
| packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx | Implemented frozen columns with sticky positioning, computed left offsets, visual separators; added cell copy (Ctrl+C/Cmd+C) handler |
| ROADMAP_CONSOLE.md | Updated Phase 11 and Phase 12 status to "✅ L1 Complete"; marked all L1 success metrics as complete; updated milestone progress bars |
</details>

The `formatTimestamp` function is duplicated between `ActivityTimeline.tsx` and `RecordComments.tsx`. This violates DRY principles and creates maintenance overhead. Consider extracting this utility function to a shared location (e.g., `packages/plugin-detail/src/utils/formatTimestamp.ts` or `packages/core/src/utils/date.ts`) and importing it in both components. This ensures consistent timestamp formatting across the application and makes future updates easier.

The new row height toggle feature lacks test coverage. Given that the codebase has comprehensive automated testing (as seen in grid-export.test.tsx and other test files), this feature should have tests to verify: 1) the row height toggle button appears when `rowHeight` is configured in the schema, 2) clicking the button cycles through 'compact', 'medium', and 'tall' modes, 3) the correct icon is displayed for each mode, and 4) the cellClassName is updated correctly for each mode. Consider adding tests in a new file like `packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/row-height-toggle.test.tsx`.

The frozen columns feature lacks test coverage. Given that the codebase has comprehensive automated testing, this feature should have tests to verify: 1) frozen columns apply sticky positioning correctly, 2) the frozen offset calculation is correct for different column widths, 3) the last frozen column receives the border and shadow styles, 4) frozen columns work correctly with the selectable checkbox column, and 5) frozen columns interact correctly with resizable and reorderable columns. Consider adding tests in `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/__tests__/data-table-frozen-columns.test.tsx`.

The cell copy feature (Ctrl+C/Cmd+C) lacks test coverage. Given that the codebase has comprehensive automated testing, this feature should have tests to verify: 1) pressing Ctrl+C or Cmd+C on a focused cell copies its value to the clipboard, 2) the copy operation works for different cell value types (strings, numbers, null/undefined), 3) the copy operation is prevented when a cell is in edit mode, and 4) the fallback behavior works when the clipboard API is unavailable. Consider adding tests in a dedicated test file for keyboard interactions.

The frozen offset calculation has a redundant conditional check. Since `columns.slice(0, colIndex)` already limits the iteration to columns before the current column index, the `if (i < frozenColumns)` check inside the reduce is redundant for frozen columns. This check will always be true for frozen columns. Consider simplifying to: `columns.slice(0, colIndex).reduce((sum, c) => sum + (typeof w === 'number' ? w : w ? parseInt(String(w), 10) || 150 : 150), selectable ? 48 : 0)`. Additionally, this calculation is performed for every cell in every frozen column on every render. Consider memoizing these offset calculations or precomputing them once per render cycle to improve performance.

The `formatTimestamp` function is duplicated between `RecordComments.tsx` and `ActivityTimeline.tsx`. This violates DRY principles and creates maintenance overhead. Consider extracting this utility function to a shared location (e.g., `packages/plugin-detail/src/utils/formatTimestamp.ts` or `packages/core/src/utils/date.ts`) and importing it in both components. This ensures consistent timestamp formatting across the application and makes future updates easier.
